content: criterion (0.8.2, requires rustc 1.86+) measures wall-clock time via statistical sampling, ideal for local dev iteration; produces HTML reports and baseline JSON files comparable with critcmp. iai-callgrind (0.16.1, July 2025) uses Valgrind/Callgrind to measure instruction counts/cache stats, runs each benchmark exactly once, is noise-free in CI virtualized environments, but requires Valgrind (Linux only), cannot exclude setup code, and misses IO/threading latency. Recommendation: use criterion for dev-time and WASM size profiling; use iai-callgrind for regression detection in GitHub Actions CI on Linux.
